title: Shoplifting Duo Start Crying After Getting Caught Stealing Lingerie
description:
#cops #police #arrest

On September 18th, 2023. Officers were called to Dillards in reference to two woman who had been caught shoplifting lingerie along with other clothing items. One of the girls tried throwing the items underneath the car when she saw the sheriff’s arrive, but her plan failed and both of them were taken back inside. They both confessed to stealing and said they came to the store with intention to steal. After conducting a search on one of their purses, cocaine was found and when they asked the lady about it, she said it wasn’t her purse and she wasn’t aware that there was drugs inside. After totalling up the stolen items, it came out to $200+ . This is the body-cam footage of the events that followed.
